top_signals.title: Philippine Growth Unexpectedly Slumps to 2.3%; Peso, Stocks Fall
top_signals.summary: Philippine economic growth slowed dramatically in the second quarter, defying expectations of a pickup, as consumer spending slowed and investment shrank. The peso and stocks fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Historian’s wife continues his research on U.S. captives in Hiroshima
top_signals.summary: Shigeaki Mori became famous when he hugged then U.S. President Barack Obama in Hiroshima in 2016. Since his death, Kayoko Mori has continued his work.
